note: Brand assets are published unchanged from assets/. No derivative, crop, recolour, vector trace or monogram is used.

assets.role: Header and footer brand mark (illustrated figure; contains no wordmark, so the text name DennySORA sits beside it).
assets.inspection: Viewed at full size and on the #0B1020 background: transparent background, white sticker outline keeps the figure legible on the dark surface. Columns outside x=191–532 are fully transparent; the header aligns the figure with negative inline margins instead of cropping.

assets.role: Master artwork of the same figure. Kept in the repository and not shipped, to avoid transferring 3 MB for a 56 px mark.
Author identity in bylines and the Open Graph image.

README hero logo (1x). Derived from the master artwork: transparent side columns trimmed to the figure (alpha bounds x=746–2087 of 2816, plus an 8 px margin), resized with Lanczos to 392 px high, WebP quality 88 with lossless alpha. Same figure, no recolouring or redrawing.
assets.inspection: Viewed at full size on the #0B1020 background: figure complete, edges clean, no halo. The master has no white sticker outline (logo.png does), so the page places a soft background glow behind it instead of filtering the image.
